why: `load(fn, 'disp')` in a function may make a variable `disp`, so `disp(g)` after it may index that variable rather than call anything (MATLAB doc 'load'): the call carries the runtime fact and its row is kept dormant whatever answers its name (project rule, MatlabRefFacts.runtime), not judged as a call on an object under a built-in's name, which with no class `gadget` and no project `disp` would be dropped.
